name: A Troll's Grim Mercy: a Cage credits Hostages freed once, not on every click (COA-10437)
contract: Quest 175053 needs 10 Hostages freed via creature 164064, credited from the Cage GO 2300662's On Use smart_scripts event (action 33). The event had event_flags 0, so SmartGameObjectAI::GossipHello re-fired the credit action on every click. event_flags now carries SMART_EVENT_FLAG_NOT_REPEATABLE, so a second use of the same spawned Cage (guid 9997016) no longer adds a second credit.

steps.label: SETUP: join the Pale Reach's normal phase
SETUP: Zuramunda Master Key unlocks the cage
the first use credits a hostage freed
a second click on the same cage does not credit again
Click it a third time for good measure
still only one credit after repeated clicks
